# Design — Skills governance F1.b

## Lockfile format

`skills/MANIFEST.yaml` example:

```yaml
# Generated by `aria-core skills lock`. Do not edit by hand.
# Bump skills, then re-run lock to refresh hashes.
schema_version: "1"
generated_at: "2026-05-04T08:00:00Z"
skills:
  - name: architecture-guardrails
    version: 1.0.0
    owner: contacto@itechpymes.com.mx
    content_sha256: 3f9...
    path: architecture-guardrails/SKILL.md
  - name: backlog-triage
    version: 1.0.0
    ...
```

Sorted alphabetically by name. Header comment makes intent obvious to
anyone who opens the file by mistake.

## Drift detection

Drift kinds detected by `CheckDrift`:

| Kind | Trigger |
|---|---|
| `added` | Skill in working tree, missing from lockfile |
| `removed` | Skill in lockfile, missing from working tree |
| `hash` | content_sha256 differs (any byte changed) |
| `version` | Frontmatter `version` field differs |

Sorted by `name+kind` for deterministic CI output. Exit code 1 on any
drift.

## CLI

```
aria-core skills lock [path]              # Write MANIFEST.yaml
aria-core skills check-drift [path] [--json]
```

## CI gate

Add a step after the existing `validate --strict` step:

```yaml
- name: Check skills lockfile committed and current
  run: /tmp/aria-core skills check-drift ./skills
```

CI fails when the dev modified a SKILL.md without re-running
`aria-core skills lock`. Local pre-commit hook (TBD) can run the same
command to catch it before push.

## CODEOWNERS

```
/skills/                        @jcguajardo82
/skills/schema/                 @jcguajardo82
/internal/skills/               @jcguajardo82
/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/skill.md   @jcguajardo82
/.github/workflows/skills-validate.yml    @jcguajardo82
```

GitHub enforces these when branch protection on `main` is set to
"Require review from Code Owners". JC configures that separately in
repo settings (one-time UI action).

When the team grows, extend CODEOWNERS with additional owners per
expertise domain.

## Test strategy

Hermetic tests in `lock_test.go` using `t.TempDir()`:
- BuildLockfile is deterministic (alphabetical).
- WriteLockfile / ReadLockfile roundtrip preserves data.
- ReadLockfile returns ErrLockfileMissing when file absent.
- CheckDrift returns no errors on a clean tree.
- CheckDrift detects added skills.
- CheckDrift detects content hash changes.
- CheckDrift detects removed skills.
- Header comment is preserved on write.

7+ tests, all hermetic, sub-second.
